answer: Stop sybils with a mesa mirror: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa plot. Each cycle it files a mirror record reflecting its work; verifiers void a record whose mirror breaks, whose delta is flat, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots, records, and deltas at 17x cost each: each mirror fits one mesa plot and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents claim once and keep rights.
